payload.text: ISSUE:0300 as its own unit on main (vc decision 100): the cut's release commit (lib/cmd/release:1033) finds no identity in a git_project repository, the harness reading no global or system config, so git guesses one and a host without a domain refuses it; -c on the fixture's own commits cannot reach that commit, so git_project sets user.name and user.email in the project's config and cut_project's two lines go; evidence: releasestatus.bats's arm with git told never to guess, red at main and green at the bank, then the arms of every git_project caller under BSD and GNU; critic-reviewed, banked as refs/bank/cc/0300, its run asked of the desk.
